svg.text: Dependency spine of the Verso blueprint in blueprint/verso. Each box is a blueprint node; each arrow is a recorded uses relation.

Read bottom to top. The chain has no open step: every node above is proved from the nodes below it together with
scheme-theoretic images and Zariski's Main Theorem (thm:zmt-factorization), the only inputs taken from outside.
Supporting nodes — ideal sheaves of finite type, blow-ups and admissible centres, strict transforms, the elementary
stability of compactifications — are recorded in the blueprint and omitted here.
